metadata.title: Genus-3 Lefschetz pencils on torus bundles
metadata.abstract: We use the breeding technique to construct genus-3 Lefschetz pencils for which the total spaces have $c_1=0$. We compute the fundamental groups of our Lefschetz pencils and identify them with the fundamental groups of certain torus bundles over tori. Using work of Friedl and Vidussi, the total spaces of our pencils are homeomorphic to torus bundles over tori. These bundles do not admit sections.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: torus bundle 上 genus-three Lefschetz pencil
analysis.workSummary: 以 breeding 构造 c₁=0 的 genus-three pencils，计算 π₁ 并以 Friedl–Vidussi 结果识别总空间 homeomorphic 于 torus-over-torus bundle；这些 bundle 无 section。
analysis.breakthrough: 得到特定 symplectic Calabi–Yau 拓扑上的低 genus pencil。
analysis.limitations: 总空间识别是 homeomorphic，不应自动称为 smooth bundle 等价。
analysis.priorityReason: 得到特定 symplectic Calabi–Yau 拓扑上的低 genus pencil。
